mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.dept_id, m.member_no, m.member_name, m.phone, m.age, m.address, m.id_card, m.card_type, (select c1.type_name from mem_member_card_type c1 where c1.type_code = m.card_type and c1.del_flag = '0' and (c1.dept_id = m.dept_id or c1.dept_id = 0) order by c1.dept_id desc, c1.type_id desc limit 1) as type_name, m.card_id, m.join_date, m.expire_date, m.total_points, COALESCE(pr.balance, 0) as available_points, m.growth_value, m.last_active_time, COALESCE(sr.cnt, 0) as seckill_count, m.status, m.remark, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time from mem_member m left join ( select r1.member_id, r1.balance from mem_points_record r1 where r1.del_flag = '0' and r1.create_time = ( select max(create_time) from mem_points_record r2 where r2.member_id = r1.member_id and r2.del_flag = '0' ) ) pr on m.member_id = pr.member_id left join ( select member_id, count(1) as cnt from mem_seckill_record where del_flag = '0' group by member_id ) sr on m.member_id = sr.member_id

choose.when: order by CASE WHEN m.member_no = #{memberNo} THEN 0 WHEN CAST(m.member_no AS UNSIGNED) = CAST(#{memberNo} AS UNSIGNED) THEN 1 WHEN m.member_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{memberNo}) THEN 2 WHEN m.member_no LIKE CONCAT(#{memberNo}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, LENGTH(m.member_no), m.member_no

mapper.insert: insert into mem_member_no_sequence (dept_id, prefix, next_value) select #{deptId}, #{prefix}, coalesce(max(cast(substr(member_no, length(#{prefix}) + 1) as signed)), 0) + 1 from mem_member where member_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%') and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' on duplicate key update sequence_id = sequence_id
mapper.update: update mem_member_no_sequence set next_value = next_value + 1, update_time = sysdate() where dept_id = #{deptId} and prefix = #{prefix}
mapper.select: select dept_name from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'

select.where: AND m.member_no like concat('%', #{memberNo}, '%') and m.del_flag = '0'

mapper.select:
AND m.member_no like concat('%', #{memberNo}, '%') and m.dept_id = #{deptId} and m.del_flag = '0'
limit 1

AND m.dept_id = #{deptId} and m.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0'
and (m.expire_date is null or m.expire_date >= #{seckillDate})
order by m.member_no

update mem_member set growth_value = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(growth_value, 0) + #{growthDelta}), last_active_time = NOW(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: select m.member_id, m.dept_id, m.member_no, m.member_name, m.phone, m.age, m.address, m.id_card, m.card_type, m.card_id, m.join_date, m.expire_date, m.total_points, COALESCE(pr.balance, 0) as available_points, m.growth_value, m.last_active_time, 0 as seckill_count, m.status, m.remark, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time from mem_member m left join ( select r1.member_id, r1.balance from mem_points_record r1 where r1.del_flag = '0' and r1.create_time = ( select max(create_time) from mem_points_record r2 where r2.member_id = r1.member_id and r2.del_flag = '0' ) ) pr on m.member_id = pr.member_id where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.last_active_time < #{threshold} and m.growth_value > 0 and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0'
